section_summary.extract_value: This Introduction reviews literature on body appreciation and self-compassion and proposes that self-compassion may buffer the negative effects of social comparison and appearance-contingent self-worth on body appreciation. It states four hypotheses about associations among body comparison, appearance contingent self-worth, self-compassion, and body appreciation but provides no methodological, sample, or measurement details and does not label any study as 'Study 1' or similar.
